name: Maryville (United States)
description: Dark blue field charged with two sets of mirrored letters M crossing at the centre, one white vertical and one red horizontal.
history: Maryville is a city in and the county seat of Blount County, Tennessee. The flag was adopted on 23 September 1975 (the winning design of a competition held for the United States Bicentennial, by Ken Bright of London, adopted by the Maryville City Council on 23 September 1975, according to Flags of the World).
